context:
The take-off code passed review round 3, but the reviewer held one part: a 'Take all' press on the owed list that takes every owed listing off TCGplayer on one confirm.
In item 14 you picked 'both'. The owed-list option you combined into it said 'one press for all of them', but the 'both' option itself named only a press per entry. So it is not clear you ruled 'Take all'.
Each listing in a Take all is sized from a fresh live read and takes off only the extra copies. A normal send undoes it. The screen already draws it, and the whole batch waits on this.

options.gain: One press clears many pulls; nothing more to build.
options.label: Keep 'Take all'
options.lose: One press lowers several listings at once.

options.gain: Each listing comes down only on its own press.
options.how: Remove the Take all button and route, then merge.
options.label: One press per entry only
options.lose: One more round of building, testing and review before anything merges.

ref: PR 965 (master-set spec); item 14 (both: press at the pull, owed list behind it); D100, never delete to lower a price
title: Should the owed take-off list on Pricing have a 'Take all' press?
why: Each listing is still sized to its own extra copies from a fresh read, and you asked for a quick way through owed take-offs.
